title: W9 MIN_LAND counter includes pre-window spawns — effective window tolerance ~0.88, not the pinned 0.95
detail: Story card W9 pins "the surge window's streaming spawn count ≥ the re-tuned expected volume × 0.95", but stream_spawned accumulates from tick 1, adding ~1199 uncapped pre-window base spawns (≤1/tick), so the window-only floor is effectively 15900 ≈ 0.88×expected.
recommended_fix: Count only in-window spawns: guard the increment with `if tick >= SURGE_START` (or subtract the pre-window tally) so the 17100 floor is window-scoped as pinned.

title: Stale W10 fixture comment names the sink "id 3" — the actual sink is id 2
detail: The fixture-fix commit (2314a22) corrected the draw from nonexistent node 3 to the real id 2 but left the prose "(id 3)" — the same wrong-id confusion that originally made the W10 pin vacuous.
recommended_fix: Update the block comment at core/demand_test.odin:495 to read "+ the sink (id 2)".
